items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...he couldn't do nothing with Kirin and them on them avatizing.

ctx.x: Boy, he could read too, boy. That guy could read.

Boy. See, he'd get on the corner when they were on them avatizing. Well, he couldn't do nothing with Kirin and them on them avatizing. But he'd play that band of all from the top. Da da da da da da da. You know, all the way from the beginning. You know, just the chorus. Da da da da da da. I know everything. All right.

Boy, that's right. Well, you're doing some good days, boy. You're doing some good days, boy. You're doing some good days. Boy, we're going to relive them days, boy. You're all right, boy. You're doing some great days, man. I understand. I said something. I was 13 years old.
